name: G502 HERO High-Performance Gaming Mouse
description: The Logitech G502 HERO is a high-performance gaming mouse designed for gamers who demand precision, customisation, comfort and reliable performance. Built around Logitech's advanced HERO 25K sensor, the G502 HERO delivers exceptional tracking accuracy and responsiveness, making it an excellent choice for competitive gaming, fast-paced FPS titles, strategy games, RPGs and everyday PC use.At the heart of the G502 HERO is the HERO 25K optical gaming sensor, engineered to provide highly accurate tracking with sensitivity of up to 25,600 DPI. The sensor delivers precise movement without smoothing, filtering or acceleration, giving you consistent control over every movement. Whether you need fast, sweeping movements or extremely precise adjustments, the G502 HERO allows you to customise sensitivity to suit your individual playing style.One of the standout features of the G502 HERO is its extensive button customisation. The mouse features 11 programmable buttons, allowing you to assign commands, macros, shortcuts and in-game actions exactly where you need them. This makes it particularly useful for games that require quick access to multiple abilities, weapons or commands. Using Logitech G HUB software, you can customise button assignments and create profiles for different games and applications.The G502 HERO also features an adjustable weight system, giving you the ability to personalise the feel and balance of the mouse. It includes five removable 3.6 g weights, which can be positioned to create a setup that feels comfortable and natural in your hand. Whether you prefer a lighter mouse for quick movements or a heavier, more substantial feel for controlled aiming, the G502 HERO can be adjusted to match your preference.For gamers who enjoy customising their setup, the G502 HERO features LIGHTSYNC RGB lighting. The RGB system allows you to personalise the mouse with a wide range of colours and lighting effects through Logitech G HUB. You can synchronise lighting effects with other compatible Logitech G gaming peripherals for a coordinated gaming environment.The mouse is designed with a comfortable, ergonomic shape that supports extended gaming sessions. Its familiar G502 design provides easy access to the programmable buttons while maintaining a secure grip. The textured scroll wheel can be used for precise scrolling and features additional functionality, including the ability to switch between click-to-click and free-spinning scrolling modes.Durability is another key feature of the G502 HERO. The primary buttons are engineered to withstand extensive use, making the mouse suitable for gamers who spend long hours playing and working at their computers. The braided cable provides added durability while maintaining flexibility during use.The G502 HERO is also designed to work seamlessly with Logitech G HUB, Logitech's gaming software platform. G HUB gives you control over button assignments, DPI settings, RGB lighting, profiles, macros and other customisation options. You can create individual profiles for different games, allowing the mouse to automatically adapt to the settings you prefer for each title.With its combination of a high-precision sensor, programmable controls, adjustable weights, RGB lighting and ergonomic design, the Logitech G502 HERO is a versatile gaming mouse built for gamers who want greater control over their gameplay. Whether you're lining up a precise shot, managing multiple commands in an MMO or simply looking for a responsive and customisable mouse for everyday PC use, the G502 HERO provides the features and flexibility needed to enhance your experience.

name: Lift Vertical Ergonomic Mouse - Graphite / Black
description: When the desk life gets you down, lift yourself up with the Logitech Lift Vertical Ergonomic Mouse. Crafted for small to medium right hands, this ergonomic mouse is designed to enhance comfort and productivity with its 57-degree vertical shape. Rest your hand naturally on the soft-textured grip, and enjoy the snug thumb rest that provides all-day coziness, helping reduce wrist strain and promote a more natural posture in your forearm. Whether working from the first light of day or late into the night, the Logitech Lift ensures your hand feels right at home.Connection Options & CompatibilityThe Logitech Lift connects effortlessly via Bluetooth Low Energy or the Logi Bolt USB receiver. The Logi Bolt USB receiver is ideal for environments with high congestion or those requiring extra security. Please note that Logi Bolt wireless products are not compatible with other Logitech USB receivers. The mouse supports a wireless range of up to 10 meters (33 feet), providing plenty of space to move around your workspace without losing connection.Precise Tracking & PerformanceFeaturing an adjustable 4000 DPI sensor, the Lift offers precise and smooth tracking on almost any surface. Whether you're doing detailed work or general browsing, the Lift's tracking resolution can be customized to meet your needs, ensuring maximum accuracy. The mouse is compatible with Logi OPTIONS+ software for further customization, allowing you to personalize your experience.Battery Life & EfficiencyPowered by a single AA battery, the Logitech Lift offers an impressive 24-month battery life (battery life may vary depending on usage and computing conditions). With its efficient energy use, you can focus on your tasks without constantly worrying about battery life.

name: Logitech(R) G309 Lightspeed Wireless Mouse - Black
description: Unlock pro-level performance with the Logitech G309 LIGHTSPEED, a feature-packed wireless gaming mouse engineered for precision, speed, and extended play. Designed to hit the sweet spot between performance and practicality, the G309 delivers advanced specs in a refined, lightweight form factor that's ready for marathon gaming sessions. Control your settings through Logitech G HUB software. You can program up to six buttons (left click, right click, scroll-click, DPI switch, and side buttons) and store up to five onboard profiles for seamless portability of your setups.

name: Logitech(R) G309 Lightspeed Wireless Mouse - White
description: Unleash wireless performance and precision with the Logitech(R) G309 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Mouse - engineered to deliver pro-level speed, accuracy, and endurance in a compact, lightweight form. Designed for gamers who demand agility without compromise, the G309 combines next-generation LIGHTSPEED wireless technology with the HERO 25K sensor for lightning-fast responsiveness and ultra-precise tracking. Weighing just 86 grams, the G309 offers exceptional balance and control, making it ideal for both competitive gaming and everyday play. Its LIGHTSPEED wireless connection ensures a lag-free experience with performance on par with wired mice, while Bluetooth(R) support provides versatile connectivity across multiple devices. Equipped with HERO 25K precision, the sensor offers up to 25,600 DPI, intelligent power management, and incredible energy efficiency for consistent, pinpoint accuracy during every battle. The G309 is also compatible with Logitech's POWERPLAY wireless charging system, so you can charge while you play - or use it with standard AA batteries for up to 300 hours of continuous gameplay on LIGHTSPEED, or 600 hours via Bluetooth(R). With mechanical switch tensioning and customizable onboard memory, it's built to keep up with your unique playstyle. A bold design, premium feel, and long-lasting performance come together to make the Logitech(R) G309 LIGHTSPEED a powerful and reliable choice for gamers who want freedom, precision, and endurance in one sleek device.

name: Logitech(R) Pro 2 Lightspeed Wireless Gaming Mouse - Black
description: Elevate your gameplay with the Logitech(R) PRO 2 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Mouse, designed in collaboration with top esports professionals for unbeatable precision, speed, and control. Featuring the groundbreaking HERO 2 sensor with up to 44,000 DPI tracking, this mouse delivers unmatched accuracy and responsiveness for every critical play. Experience LIGHTSPEED wireless technology for ultra-low latency performance trusted by pros worldwide, and enjoy the reliability and feel of LIGHTFORCE hybrid switches, combining optical speed with mechanical tactility. The ambidextrous design with magnetic, customizable side buttons makes it perfect for both left- and right-handed gamers, allowing you to configure it exactly to your playstyle. Weighing just 77 grams, the PRO 2 LIGHTSPEED offers smooth, effortless control and up to 95 hours of battery life on a single charge. With USB-C fast charging, onboard memory, and RGB lighting, it's built for serious performance and personalization.

name: Logitech(R) Pro 2 Lightspeed Wireless Gaming Mouse - White
description: Elevate your gaming experience with the PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2 Wireless Gaming Mouse, the next evolution of our championship-winning design. This esports icon has been meticulously crafted to deliver unparalleled performance with its ultra-lightweight 60g build, ensuring swift and effortless movement. Featuring the latest innovations such as LIGHTFORCE hybrid switches and the HERO 2 sensor, this mouse promises the precision and speed required by top-tier gamers. Experience the ultimate in gaming technology with LIGHTFORCE hybrid optical-mechanical switches, providing ultra-low latency and a crisp, tactile click. The PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2 is equipped with the HERO 2 sensor, the most advanced optical sensor in gaming, offering incredible tracking at over 500+ IPS and up to 32,000 DPI. Whether you're executing rapid maneuvers or precise sniper shots, this mouse's zero smoothing, acceleration, and filtering ensure flawless accuracy. Performance meets reliability with an impressive 1000Hz report rate and maximum speeds of >888 IPS and >88 G acceleration. Every click, slide, and lift is recorded in real-time, making sure you never miss an opportunity to strike. Plus, the onboard memory lets you store your settings directly on the mouse, making it easy to switch between devices or setups. With the Logitech G HUB software, advanced features are fully customizable, allowing you to fine-tune the mouse to your exact needs, from DPI settings to RGB lighting and beyond. Battery life is no longer a worry with the G PRO 2. With up to 95 hours of continuous playtime without lighting, or 60 hours with default lighting, you can focus on your game without interruptions. Plus, the mouse is designed to perform optimally with a 1000Hz polling rate for ultra-responsive performance. The G PRO 2 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Mouse is your ultimate weapon for taking your gaming experience to the next level, offering uncompromised precision, speed, and comfort for the most competitive gamers.

Swap in the fiber module whenever you need to mark or engrave metal, anodized aluminum, plastics or other reflective surfaces - perfect for branding tools, engraving jewelry, or producing durable industrial markings that a diode laser simply can't achieve.A Laser Module Storage Bag is included to safely store whichever module isn't currently mounted, protecting it from dust and accidental damage between jobs.This combination is ideal for workshops and small production setups that need both cutting depth and metal-marking capability from a single enclosed, safety-rated machine.

name: Creality K3 3D Printer - 260*260*260mm
description: The Creality K3 introduces KliTek, Creality's next-generation nozzle-changing system that reinvents how multicolour and multi-material 3D printing works. Instead of pushing multiple filaments through one shared nozzle, the K3 swaps between up to four complete, compact nozzle assemblies - each with its own nozzle, hotend and filament path. A nozzle change takes under 4.8 seconds, and a full colour or material change completes in under 15 seconds, with under 25-micron repositioning accuracy to keep colour transitions clean.Because each filament runs through its own dedicated melt path, the K3 dramatically cuts cross-contamination and purge waste - lab comparison showed a saving of up to 80% filament waste versus a shared-nozzle machine on a multi-colour print. The system also allows mixed nozzle sizes within a single print and handles soft TPU down to 80A Shore hardness at up to triple the speed of typical consumer machines.Built on a CoreXY motion platform with step-servo motors, the K3 prints at speeds up to 500mm/s with 20,000mm/s2 acceleration, inside an enclosed 260x260x260mm chamber heated to 100degC, with a 300degC-capable direct-drive hotend. Automated monitoring covers 37 sensors, including nozzle offset/flow calibration, air-print detection, spaghetti detection, hotend and clog detection, and filament runout/tangle detection - backed by a built-in camera and touchscreen for full remote and on-device control via Creality Print or Creality Cloud.

name: Ellies Surge Secure Fridge Safe
description: Keep your refrigeration appliances safe during power fluctuations with the ELLIES 1-Way Fridge Surge Protector Adaptor. name: Creality Ender 3-V3-KE 3D Printer 220x220x240
description: "Introducing the Creality Ender 3-V3-KE 3D Printer. This printer includes CR-touch auto bed leveling, a touch screen, and introduces linear rails on the X and Y axis, and dual Z axis leadscrews. It also includes more advanced firmware and Wi-Fi capabilities.Key Features: Direct drive extruder - Direct drive extruders are mounted right above the hot end, and push the filament directly into it, as opposed to a side mounted bowden extruder setup.We prefer direct drive extruders to bowden since they are less prone to jamming and typically require less maintenance. they also are much easier to use with flexible materialsAuto bed leveling - auto bed leveling will ensure your prints have perfect first layers every time and greatly reduce issues with bed adhesion. When using an auto-levelingsystem, the probe allows better tolerances for slightly warped print beds by measuring and compensating for any inconsistencies. Without this feature, you'll need to adjust thebed level manually using nuts on each corner of the print bed.Easy to assemble - This 3D printer is shipped with most of the parts pre-assembled, and you will only need to attach a few components and connect a couple cables in order toget the machine ready to print.Linear rail motion system - Linear rails provide added stability to the moving parts of the printer, allowing higher printing speeds without sacrificing quality. Keep in mind that themost important factor to consider when optimizing for print speed is the flow rate of filament, which depends on the hot end and nozzle size moreso than the motion system.Affordable - This printer does not include a lot of frills, but offers a good experience for a low price point. While this low price means you won't be getting the most premiumfeatures, you can still get a lot out of these machines if you are willing to put up with some missing quality of life features.Has touch screen - having a touch screen isn't a deal-maker or breaker, but it is a convenient feature that makes it easier to navigate the interface when you are printing filesand configuring 3D printing settings.PEI build surface has good balance of adhesion and part removal - PEI beds are one of the more premium build surface options, and for good reason. They offer great firstlayer adhesion with no sprays or other treatments, and can be flexed to quickly remove parts. You'll need to clean the bed with a solvent like acetone or IPA every so often tomaintain the bed's adhesion.""What's in the box""1 x Creality Ender 3-V3-KE 3D Printer1 x User Manual ""

name: Creality Halot-X1 Resin Printer 211.6x118.3x200mm
description: Unlock a new level of detail and reliability with the Creality HALOT-X1 Resin 3D Printer. Its generous 211.6 x 118.3 x 200 mm build volume enables large and batch prints, while a blazing 10.1-inch 16K monochrome LCD delivers resolution at just 14 x 19 um, ensuring precision and clarity for every layer.A revolutionary level-free motion structure keeps the build plate stationary while the vat and optical module move, dramatically reducing vibration, simplifying first-layer setup, and increasing print consistency. The 92-zone Intelligent Exposure system enables selective curing to enhance detail, reduce screen wear, and boost efficiency.Upgrade to the optional Auto-Feed Unit (AFU) for smarter resin management: it auto-tops resin, recovers excess, and heats resin for optimal conditions - especially helpful during long or pressure-sensitive prints.Built for efficiency, the HALOT-X1 reaches up to 170 mm/h print speeds, offers RFID resin identification, and simplifies model removal with a twist-to-release build plate-all packed into a sleek, enclosed design with touchscreen and Wi-Fi support for seamless operation.

name: Creality Halot-X1 Resin Printer Auto-Feeder Unit
description: Elevate your resin printing workflow with the Creality HALOT-X1 Auto Feed Unit (AFU). Designed for seamless integration with the HALOT-X1 printer, this intelligent accessory handles every aspect of resin delivery - from auto-refill and temperature control to material recognition and waste reduction.The AFU uses RFID resin identification for automatic exposure settings and offers laser-assisted level detection to refill resin only when needed. Its built-in heating system pre-warms resin to 30-45 degC, improving flow and print consistency. Plus, it recovers unused resin post-print, meaning zero spill, zero waste, and no interruptions during long or complex jobs.

name: Creality Halot-X1 Resin Printer with AFU unit Combo
description: The Creality HALOT-X1 Resin 3D Printer Combo pairs the high-precision HALOT-X1 printer with the smart Auto Feed Unit (AFU), delivering a fully automated resin printing experience. This combination ensures uninterrupted printing, precise detail, and hassle-free resin handling-ideal for makers, designers, and professionals in South Africa.The HALOT-X1's 16K mono LCD produces ultra-detailed prints at 14 x 19 um resolution, while its level-free stationary build plate improves consistency and eliminates frequent recalibration. With a large 211.6 x 118.3 x 200 mm build volume and up to 170 mm/h speeds, it's built for productivity.Adding the AFU takes convenience further: it features RFID resin recognition, auto-top-off refills, and resin heating (30-45 degC) for optimal viscosity. It even recovers unused resin, reducing waste and lowering costs. Together, the printer and AFU combo make resin 3D printing smarter, cleaner, and more reliable.

name: Creality - Halot-X1 Max 16K Resin Printer
description: The Creality HALOT-X1 Max is the flagship of the HALOT-X1 series: a large-format 16K resin 3D printer built as a desktop smart factory for animation studios, miniature and wargaming studios, and small-scale 3D-printed footwear production. A 13.5-inch 16K screen and a 302.4 x 161.98 x 350 mm (17.1L) build volume let you print tall figures in one piece, fill the plate with batches of miniatures, or produce a full pair of adult shoes in a single run.Instead of the usual cantilever arm, the HALOT-X1 Max uses four lead screws and four linear rails, and keeps the build platform static while the light source moves. This removes platform wobble and vibration-induced layer lines for consistently clean surfaces. A 2nd-gen honeycomb matrix light source with 76-zone independent exposure and 13,000-point full-area calibration delivers even curing across the whole screen.Built for unattended production, it combines 40degC active chamber heating, eight onboard sensors including an AI camera and residue detection, free leveling, 12 CFM negative-pressure ventilation with activated carbon filtration, and CreFarm OS fleet management for running multiple printers from one place. An optional 5L HyperFeed system automatically refills and recovers resin and identifies RFID-tagged resin bottles.

The fanless design guarantees silent operation, making it suitable for noise-sensitive environments such as studios, clinics, and home offices.

name: MOZA Universal Hub Kit
description: The MOZA Universal Hub Kit is a two-in-one accessory designed to expand and simplify any sim racing setup. At its core is an all-metal USB hub that consolidates multiple MOZA devices - wheels, pedals, dash, shifter and handbrake - into a single USB connection to your PC, freeing up ports and reducing cable clutter. With 4 input ports (3 expansion ports plus 1 dedicated pedal port), it supports simultaneous connection of MOZA's KS Wheel, FSR/FSR2 Formula Wheel, Vision GS Wheel, TSW Truck Wheel, SR-P Lite pedals and other upcoming ecosystem products. A dual power supply system keeps power-hungry peripherals running stably, even over USB 2.0.The kit also includes a wheelbase mount adapter, CNC-machined from aviation-grade aluminium for a solid, precise connection. Featuring three 50mm and six 70mm threaded bolt patterns, it lets racers mount MOZA steering wheels onto popular third-party direct-drive bases, making it easy to mix and match MOZA and third-party hardware in one rig.Included in the box: the Universal Hub, wheelbase mount adapter, a retractable coil cord (3m) for the FSR wheel, a USB Type-B cable (1.8m), a USB Type-C cable (1.8m), and adhesive strips for tidy cable routing.

name: ESX steering wheel for XBOX
description: The MOZA ESX Steering Wheel brings MOZA's direct drive racing technology to console with official Xbox licensing, delivering plug-and-play performance on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and PC. Built for durability and comfort, it features a solid aluminum alloy rim and faceplate paired with non-slip, sweat-proof ISF PU grips that hold up through intense racing sessions. The wheel offers 22 fully customizable buttons - including two joysticks, ABXY keys, a D-pad and paddle-shifter equivalents for the triggers - giving racers comprehensive on-the-fly control without leaving the wheel. A 10-segment high-brightness RGB flow-shift LED bar provides a fully adjustable, dynamic RPM indicator via MOZA Pit House software. The wheel connects using MOZA's all-metal quick-release system, widely regarded as one of the fastest and most secure in the industry, enabling effortless wheel swaps between sessions.

name: MOZA E-stop Switch
description: The MOZA E-Stop Switch is a safety-critical accessory designed for peace of mind on powerful direct drive rigs, particularly high-torque bases like the R9, R12, R16 and R21. Housed in robust aluminium alloy construction, it offers three distinct connection and protection modes tailored to different needs. In Mode 1, the switch connects directly to a PC via USB - pressing it instantly deactivates force feedback, which is restored immediately on release, ideal for quickly resolving a momentary issue without losing race progress. Mode 2 connects to the wheelbase's DASH port via an RJ11 cable (6-pin), providing the same temporary FFB cut-off and restoration at hardware level. Mode 3 connects to the dedicated E-STOP port via an RJ9 cable (4-pin) for a full power cut-off - pressing the switch completely powers down the base, which must then be manually restarted via the base's power button (some games may also require a restart to restore force feedback). This tiered approach lets racers choose the right balance of convenience and safety for their setup.

name: MOZA Vision GS Steering Wheel
description: The MOZA Vision GS Steering Wheel pushes sim racing hardware into new territory as MOZA's first wheel with a built-in customizable touchscreen UI. Measuring 310 mm in diameter, it's built around a 2.85-inch high-definition circular touchscreen running at 60Hz, driven by an onboard quad-core processor for real-time display rendering. Users can slide the display up, down, left or right to switch between 10 built-in UI presets or build their own custom dash layout, with additional designs shareable via the MOZA community platform. Construction pairs an aerospace-grade aluminium backplate with a carbon-fibre-reinforced composite faceplate and hand-stitched microfibre leather grips, delivering a premium, rigid feel. The wheel is loaded with 72 programmable inputs across short-travel backlit buttons, rotary encoders, joysticks and top-mounted RPM indicator LEDs (16.7 million colours). Dual magnetic paddle shifters, built from forged carbon fibre with non-contact Hall sensors accurate to 0.03 mm, support both single and dual-clutch modes for titles like iRacing and the F1 series. The wheel connects via MOZA's aerospace-grade aluminium quick release and supports both wireless and conductive slip-ring communication, ensuring compatibility with all MOZA bases and select third-party systems.

name: CRP2 Performance Kit
description: The MOZA CRP2 Performance Kit lets sim racers fully customize the feel, resistance and travel of their CRP2 brake pedal to match their driving discipline. The kit includes 10 tension springs across five stiffness levels (white 1.6, black 2.0, blue 2.6, red 3.3, purple 4.0 - two of each), 8 damping blocks and 4 aluminium blocks. Combined with the CRP2's original components, these parts create up to 1,764 possible configurations, ranging from a soft, long-travel feel suited to rally racing to the short-travel, high-resistance "hard brake" sensation used in top-tier categories like F1, F2 and GT3. The included aluminium blocks can be used to virtually eliminate pedal travel, turning the CRP2 into a near-pure pressure-based system with almost zero brake force response time - ideal for racers who prioritize precise, consistent modulation over physical pedal movement.

name: MOZA R9 V3 Direct Drive Wheel Base
description: The MOZA R9 V3 is a professional-grade direct drive wheelbase built for racers who demand precision without compromise. Powered by a custom-built servo motor delivering 9Nm of peak torque and 180W peak power, it's paired with a 21-bit magnetic encoder and a 280MHz high-performance processor that divide each rotation into 2,097,152 precise steps - an angular resolution of just 0.00017deg - for ultra-smooth control and instant response. MOZA's NexGen 4.0 force feedback algorithm delivers sharper curb detail, clearer surface textures and quicker reaction to tyre slip, with new cogging torque compensation for smoother steering and a more natural, progressive force curve. The V3 revision adds support for iRacing's 360Hz mode. Built from aviation-grade aluminium alloy for a lightweight yet rigid housing, the base includes intelligent temperature monitoring to maintain stable performance during extended sessions, and connects to the wheel via an automotive-grade conductive slip ring rated for over 5 million revolutions. Full integration with MOZA Pit House Control Center and the MOZA app allows racers to load presets, tune settings, switch between driving modes (GT, formula, rally, drifting, karting and more) and update firmware across their whole ecosystem with a single click.

name: MOZA Universal Mounting Plate
description: The MOZA Universal Mounting Plate is a versatile dual-device mount built to bring a shifter and handbrake together on a single, ergonomic bracket. Constructed from high-strength steel for excellent load-bearing capacity and rigidity, its ambidextrous layout supports both left- and right-hand drive configurations, maximizing flexibility while minimizing footprint. The plate supports multiple mounting methods: tabletop use via the optional MOZA AB9 table clamp, direct installation onto 40 Series aluminium profile rigs, or custom DIY frame setups. When paired with the AB9 clamp, mounting surface height is adjustable between 84 mm and 122 mm, while the dedicated handbrake mount offers three angle positions in 9deg increments with 20 mm spacing, letting racers dial in the ideal ergonomic layout. While optimized for MOZA gear, the plate also supports selected third-party shifters and handbrakes from brands including Fanatec, SIMAGIC and Conspit.

name: MOZA - R5 Pro Racing Simulator Kit
description: The MOZA R5 Pro Racing Simulator brings together the main hardware required to begin direct drive sim racing in one complete package.It includes a 6 Nm direct drive wheel base, ES Lite Steering Wheel, SRP Lite2 Pedals and a desk clamp. Designed for users moving from controllers, gear-driven wheels or belt-driven systems, it provides a straightforward entry into direct drive racing.The upgraded R5 Pro Wheel Base delivers 6 Nm of constant direct drive torque, providing greater force feedback strength and additional performance headroom for more detailed, responsive and consistent feedback. A 21-bit high-resolution magnetic encoder with more than two million points of resolution captures finer steering movement, helping reproduce subtle changes in grip, road texture and vehicle balance with greater precision. The upgraded SRP Lite2 Pedals provide a more refined driving experience while also serving as a foundation for future upgrades. Users can further customize pedal feel with optional Brake Performance Kits and Throttle & Clutch Performance Kits, allowing the system to evolve alongside their driving skills.For truck simulation users, MOZA also offers the R5 Pro Truck Driving Simulator. It uses the same R5 Pro platform with the MOZA TSW Truck Wheel, providing a larger, truck-style steering experience for long-haul driving and commercial vehicle simulation.

name: Omada 5-Port Gigabit Smart Switch with 1-Port PoE++ in and 4-Port PoE+ out
description: The TP-Link Omada SG2005P-PD is a compact yet powerful 5-port Gigabit smart switch designed to extend power and data reliably in demanding enterprise and outdoor networking environments. Featuring PoE passthrough, advanced management capabilities, and a rugged weatherproof design, this switch is ideal for long-range deployments such as surveillance systems, outdoor wireless access points, and remote network extensions.One of the standout features of the SG2005P-PD is its ability to support up to 200 meters PoE transmission distance, effectively doubling the standard PoE range from 100 meters to 200 meters while maintaining full Gigabit speeds. This makes it perfectly suited for powering and connecting long-distance IP cameras, outdoor access points, and edge network devices without the need for additional power infrastructure.

name: TP-Link SG2210MP JetStream 10-Port Gigabit Smart Switch with 8-Port PoE+
description: TL-SG2210MP JetStream 10-Port Gigabit Smart Switch is a powerful and feature-rich networking solution designed for small to medium-sized business environments that require reliable performance, advanced security, and centralized management. Equipped with a 150 W PoE budget, the switch features 8 IEEE 802.3at/af-compliant PoE+ Gigabit ports, capable of delivering both data and power over a single Ethernet cable. This makes it ideal for powering devices such as IP cameras, wireless access points, IP phones, and other PoE-enabled equipment, reducing infrastructure complexity and installation costs.

name: TP-Link SG2210P JetStream 10-Port Gigabit Smart Switch with 8-Port PoE+
description: This JetStream smart switch features 8 Gigabit RJ45 ports, all supporting Power over Ethernet (PoE) with a total power budget of 53W, making it ideal for powering IP cameras, VoIP phones, and wireless access points without the need for separate power supplies. It also includes 2 Gigabit SFP slots for flexible uplink options, allowing seamless integration into larger network infrastructures. The TL-SG2210P supports a rich set of Layer 2 management features, including 802.1Q VLAN, Link Aggregation Groups (LAG), Access Control Lists (ACL), IGMP Snooping, Storm Control, and Port Mirroring, which help optimize traffic flow and enhance network performance. With L2/L3/L4 Quality of Service (QoS), the switch ensures smooth handling of latency-sensitive applications such as voice and video. Security is reinforced through 802.1X authentication, port security, and DoS defence, protecting the network from unauthorized access and malicious threats. Management is flexible and user-friendly, with support for Web GUI, Command Line Interface (CLI), SNMP, and RMON, allowing administrators to monitor and configure the switch with ease. Additionally, the TL-SG2210P incorporates energy-efficient technologies that can reduce power consumption by up to 50%, contributing to a greener network setup. Compact and rack-mountable, this switch is a reliable and scalable solution for businesses looking to expand their network while maintaining control, security, and performance.The TL-SG2210P is part of TP-Link's Omada Software Defined Networking (SDN) ecosystem, which allows for centralized cloud management, making it an excellent choice if you're already using or planning to use other Omada devices like access points.

name: TP-Link SG2428P JetStream 28-Port Gigabit Smart Switch with 24-Port PoE+
description: TP-Link SG2428P JetStream 28-Port Gigabit Smart Switch with 24-Port PoE+250 W PoE Budget: 24x 802.3at/af-compliant PoE+ ports with a total power supply of 250 W*.Full Gigabit Ports: 24x gigabit PoE+ ports and 4x gigabit SFP Slots provide high-speed connections.Integrated into Omada SDN: Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP)**, Centralized Cloud Management, and Intelligent Monitoring.Centralized Management: Cloud access and Omada app for ultra convenience and easy management.Static Routing: Helps route internal traffic for more efficient use of network resources.Robust Security Strategies: IP-MAC-Port Binding, ACL, Port Security, DoS Defend, Storm control, DHCP Snooping, 802.1X, Radius Authentication, and more.Optimize Voice and Video Applications: L2/L3/L4 QoS and IGMP snooping.IPv6: IPv6 support with dual IPv4/IPv6 stack, MLD snooping, IPv6 neighbor discovery.

name: TP-Link SG3452P JetStream 52-Port Gigabit L2+ Managed Switch with 48-Port PoE+
description: The TP-Link SG3452P JetStream 52-Port Gigabit L2+ Managed Switch delivers powerful performance, flexible management, and reliable connectivity for business, enterprise, and surveillance networks. Featuring 48x Gigabit PoE+ ports and 4x Gigabit SFP uplink slots, it provides high-speed wired connections while powering IP cameras, access points, VoIP phones, and other PoE-enabled devices-all through a single network cable.With a total PoE power budget of up to 370W, the SG3452P ensures stable power distribution across devices, making it ideal for medium to large deployments. Advanced L2+ and L3 features such as static routing, VLAN support, QoS, IGMP Snooping, and link aggregation offer enhanced network performance, traffic control, and security.Managed via the Omada Software Defined Networking (SDN) platform, the switch supports centralised cloud management, remote monitoring, and zero-touch provisioning, making it easy to scale your network as your business grows. Robust security features including ACL, IP-MAC-Port binding, and storm control safeguard your network against threats.The TP-Link SG3452P is built to deliver enterprise-grade reliability, high PoE capacity, and intelligent management for demanding business environments.

name: TP-Link Tapo RV20 Max Robot Vacuum Cleaner
description: Upgrade your home cleaning experience with the Tapo RV20 Max, a high-end robot vacuum and mop built to handle floors, carpets, messes and tight spaces. The robot supports multi-floor mapping, no-go zones, virtual walls, and zone- or room-specific cleaning so you can customise which parts of your home it cleans and when.Mopping mode adds wet cleaning with electric water flow control, with 3 levels of water flow to suit different hard floors. name: TP-Link Tapo Smart Water Leak Sensor
description: The Tapo T300 is a highly effective and affordable solution for protecting your home from water damage. When a leak is detected, it immediately triggers a loud 90 dB siren on the unit itself and sends instant notifications to your smartphone, allowing for quick intervention even when you're away from home.

name: TP-Link Tapo Smart Sensor Starter Kit
description: Give your home the smart protection it deserves with the TP-Link Tapo T30 Kit, a compact starter kit that combines motion sensing, door/window detection and hub alarm functions. It's ideal for homes, apartments, or any entryway where you want real-time alerts and automation without installing cameras.At its core is the Tapo H100 hub, which connects to the app and acts as the central alarm and control point. The kit includes one T100 motion sensor and two T110 contact sensors (for doors/windows). Whenever motion is detected or a door/window opens, the hub triggers a built-in alarm (approx. 90 dB) and pushes a notification to your phone - keeping you aware no matter where you are.These smart sensors can also power automation. For example, opening a door could trigger lights, or motion in a hallway can turn on your smart bulbs - everything tied together under scenes you define in the Tapo app.With battery-powered sensors (no wires required) and support for low-power wireless protocols via the hub, devices in this kit are built for longevity - with estimated battery life up to 2 years.Setup is tool-free. You mount the sensors using 3M adhesive or magnetic mounts, plug in the hub, and connect everything via the app. It also supports local mode, so your sensors continue functioning within your home network even if the internet is down.

name: ViewSonic 16" USB-C Portable Business Monitor

name: Volkano gaming Arc Ultra-Lightweight Rechargeable Gaming Mouse
description: Meet the Volkano Arc UL, a lightweight gaming mouse built for fast flicks and all-day comfort at just around 51 g (excl. receiver). name: Volkano Gaming Shadow X1 Wired Gaming Keyboard with RGB lighting
description: Level up your setup with the Volkano Shadow X1 gaming keyboard-a reliable wired gaming keyboard designed for quiet performance and everyday durability. The silent membrane design keeps keystrokes low-noise for late-night sessions, while RGB backlighting adds a bold, colourful glow to your desk. Simply plug in via the 1.5 m detachable USB cable and you're ready to play-no drivers, no fuss.Built for comfort and control, Shadow X1 offers a strong, stable structure with a pleasing touch feel for long sessions. Handy multimedia buttons put volume and playback within easy reach, so you can adjust on the fly without leaving your game. With a tested 5-million key life, it's engineered to handle intense practice and clutch moments alike. Its compact footprint helps keep your space tidy, making it a great fit for home offices and gaming nooks.If you're looking for a dependable RGB-backlit keyboard that's simple, sturdy, and satisfying to use, Shadow X1 delivers straight out the box.

name: Volkano Gaming Phantom X1 Wired Mechanical keyboard with RGB lighting
description: Power up your setup with the Volkano Phantom X1 membrane gaming keyboard-a precision wired mechanical keyboard built for speed, reliability and style. Linear red switch mechanisms deliver smooth, consistent key presses with minimal tactile resistance, ideal for rapid double-taps and clutch moments. Turn heads with vivid rainbow lighting and 22 dynamic effects, and tune visibility with four brightness levels to suit late-night or daytime play.Engineered for long-term durability, the Phantom X1 features double-injection keycaps that won't fade and a tough plastic top cover for everyday resilience. detachable 1.5 m USB-C cable keeps your desk neat and travel-ready. It's true plug-and-play with no drivers required, so you can jump straight into the action on Windows or Android devices.With a 50-million keystroke lifetime and a comfortable 104-key layout, the Phantom X1 blends dependable performance with striking aesthetics-perfect for gamers who want accuracy, speed and a clean, wired connection.

name: Volkano Gaming Phantom X2  TKL Mechanical Tri-Mode Wireless Keyboard
description: Meet the Volkano Phantom X2, a compact mechanical wireless keyboard that gives you pro-grade control without taking over your desk. The TKL (82-key) layout frees up mouse space for low-sens flicks while keeping essential function and arrow keys close at hand. Tri-Mode (2.4G, Bluetooth, or wired USB) lets you connect the way you want-pair to your laptop or tablet on the couch, then plug in for tournament-steady performance at your desk.Outemu self-lubricating switches deliver consistently smooth presses, rated for 50 million key strokes for long-term reliability. A plastic five-layer gasket mount softens keystrokes for a more comfortable sound and feel, while FR4 double-sided PCB and a tough build add everyday durability. Customise your look with vibrant RGB backlighting, and make quick adjustments with the multifunction knob-perfect for volume, track skipping, or lighting control.Engineered for accuracy, the Phantom X2 includes full-key anti-ghosting so every command registers, even during rapid combos. PBT double-shot keycaps resist shine and guarantee legends that won't fade. A generous 4000mAh battery means fewer charge stops, and the included 1.8 m shielded USB cable keeps things neat when you go wired.

name: Volkano Gaming Obsidian X1 TKL Mechanical Tri-mode keyboard with Red switches
description: Meet the Volkano Obsidian X1-your compact TKL mechanical keyboard purpose-built for fast, reliable play. The 87-key layout clears extra mouse space while keeping all the essentials for competitive gaming and everyday typing. As a mechanical gaming keyboard, it pairs smooth red switches with a five-layer plastic gasket mount to deliver a comfortable, cushioned key feel with a satisfying sound profile.Go cable-free or plug in when you need to: the Obsidian X1 is a Tri-Mode wireless keyboard that connects via 2.4G, Bluetooth or USB. Enjoy a rapid 1000 Hz polling rate in 2.4G and wired modes (125 Hz on Bluetooth) for responsive control. Vivid RGB backlighting lets you personalise your look, while full-key anti-ghosting ensures every press registers during intense combos.Built to last, the FR4 double-sided PCB and PBT double-shot keycaps resist wear, and the glass nameplate with silver lettering adds a premium finish. An 8 000 mAh battery powers long sessions, and the braided 1.8 m cable keeps your desk neat when charging or playing wired. A 2-in-1 keycap and switch puller is included for easy maintenance and customisation.

name: Volkano gaming Helm X1 Pro Wireless Gaming headphone with Tri-mode and ENC mic
description: Gear up with the Volkano Helm X1-your do-it-all gaming headset for crisp sound, clear chat and marathon comfort. As a wireless gaming headset, it gives you the freedom to choose how you play: ultra-responsive 2.4 GHz for competitive matches, Bluetooth 5.3 for phones and tablets, or classic 3.5 mm cable when you need universal plug-in reliability. With low-latency 2.4 GHz (under 30 ms) and a massive 2 000 mAh battery delivering over 45 hours of play (even with RGB on), you're set for back-to-back sessions.Team comms stay sharp thanks to a detachable ENC boom mic plus an inner ENC mic that work to reduce background noise. 50 mm dynamic drivers deliver punchy bass and clear highs across a wide 20-20 kHz range, while a friendly 32 ? impedance pairs well with consoles, PCs and mobile devices. Charge fully in about 3.5 hours and enjoy a stable wireless range of up to 15 m.Whether you're on console, PC or mobile, Helm X1 keeps you connected, comfortable and focused on the win.

name: Volkano Gaming Solace Series Wired Gaming headphones
description: Step up your setup with the Volkano Solace Series wired gaming headset, engineered to deliver powerful, detailed audio and crystal-clear communication. The oversized 50mm drivers produce punchy lows and crisp highs, while the gaming headset with mic design ensures your voice comes through clearly to teammates. With a high 108dB sensitivity and 32? impedance, the Solace is easy to drive from PCs, laptops, and many controllers, giving you robust volume and presence without external amplification.Designed for focused team chat, the unidirectional microphone captures your voice while helping reduce off-axis sounds, so callouts stay clean when the action intensifies. A full 20Hz-20kHz frequency response means you'll hear deep rumbles, footsteps, and ambient detail that make the difference between winning and losing. As Volkano gaming headphones, Solace keeps things simple and reliable with a lag-free wired connection-no batteries, no dropouts, just consistent performance match after match.Whether you're grinding ranked, coordinating raids, or diving into story mode, Solace gives you the edge with immersive sound and clear comms that keep your squad synced.

name: Volkano gaming Eclipse X1 Tri-mode Ultra Lightweight Gaming Headphone - Black
description: Step into your next session with the Volkano Eclipse X1 gaming headset-built for comfort, clarity and long playtime. Its ultra-lightweight design helps reduce pressure during marathon matches, while 40 mm speaker drivers deliver lively, detailed audio that lets you track every footstep and skill cue. If you're after a lightweight gaming headset that won't weigh you down, the Eclipse X1 is made for all-day wear.Communication is just as important as sound. A sensitive microphone (-38 +/-3 dB) captures your voice clearly for squad calls, scrims and study chats. With a generous battery rated for up to 40 hours of use and a fast 2-hour recharge, you'll spend less time tethered to a charger and more time in the game. The Eclipse X1 carries the Tri-Mode model name, giving you versatile use across day-to-day scenarios.From crisp highs to solid mids, the tuned 20-20 kHz response brings your entertainment to life, while a 32 ? impedance pairs well with everyday devices. Whether you're gaming, watching or working, Eclipse X1 keeps things light, comfortable and clear.

Monitoring and control functions allow you to track battery level, load status, and regenerate firmware remotely.

name: Sony WF-LC900 Linkbuds Clip True Wireless Earphones - Black
description: Experience music while staying connected to the world around you with the Sony WF-LC900 LinkBuds Clip True Wireless Earphones. Designed for everyday convenience, these innovative open-ear earphones combine comfortable wear, balanced audio, and clear call quality in a lightweight, clip-style design. Whether you are working, walking, exercising, or listening to your favourite playlists, the LinkBuds Clip lets you enjoy your audio while remaining aware of your surroundings.The open-ear design allows you to listen to music, podcasts, and other audio without completely blocking your ears. This makes the LinkBuds Clip ideal for users who want to stay aware of nearby conversations and environmental sounds while enjoying their favourite content. The ergonomic clip-style fit is designed for comfortable, secure wear throughout the day, while the included Air Fitting Cushions allow you to customise the fit to suit your preferences.Enjoy balanced, clear sound with Sony's audio technology, designed to deliver an enjoyable listening experience across different types of content. With three listening modes, you can adapt your audio to suit your environment. Standard mode is ideal for everyday listening, Voice Boost helps make voices easier to hear in noisy surroundings, and Sound Leakage Reduction helps minimise sound escaping from the earphones in quieter environments.For calls, the LinkBuds Clip features AI-powered Voice Pickup Technology to help capture your voice clearly and reduce the impact of background noise. Whether you are taking business calls, chatting with friends, or joining online meetings, these earphones are designed to support clear communication throughout your day.With up to 37 hours of total battery life when used with the charging case, the LinkBuds Clip helps keep your music going for longer. Bluetooth connectivity and multipoint connection make it easy to connect to compatible devices and switch between two connected devices. The IPX4 water-resistance rating also helps protect the earphones against splashes and sweat, making them suitable for everyday activities and workouts.Combining open-ear listening, personalised comfort, versatile sound modes, and convenient wireless connectivity, the Sony WF-LC900 LinkBuds Clip True Wireless Earphones are an excellent choice for users who want to enjoy their audio while staying connected to the world around them.

name: Sony LinkBuds S (Black) Noise Cancelling TWS Earphones
description: The LinkBuds S Noise-Canceling True Wireless In-Ear Headphones from Sony in black provides a high-end audio experience that adapts to your lifestyle and behavior. Listen to music free of distraction with active noise cancellation, which is automatically adjusted based on where you are and what you're doing. When communicating, focused voice pickup automatically pauses playback so you can speak, and embedded AI keeps your voice clear on hands-free calls. The music you play is made to sound dynamic and detailed thanks to Hi-Res Audio Wireless and DSEE Extreme support. These features and more can be enjoyed for up to 20 hours with the included charging case.Adaptive Sound ControlOver time, the LinkBuds S will use Adaptive Sound Control to learn your behavior and recognize locations that you frequently visit. It uses this knowledge to automatically adjust its active noise cancellation's ambient sound settings. The result is an immersive listening experience that is continuously optimized as you move through your day.Speak-to-ChatEasily speak to others without having to remove your earphones or tap its controls. Sony's voice pickup technology knows when you start to talk and will automatically pause the music so you can have a conversation. Once you're done talking, the LinkBuds S resumes playback.Auto Play and PauseThis additional automatic feature can detect when you pull out one or both earphones or go on a call. Once you do, the LinkBuds S will pause playback until you put them back in or end the call.Bespoke PlaybackWith a combination of Sony's Headphones Connect app, the Auto Play app, and either Spotify or Endel app, the LinkBuds S can actually match your behavior by triggering specific songs to play. Have it play something relaxing when out on a stroll, or something to get you focused when at work.High-Quality AudioSony equipped the LinkBuds S with 5mm drivers that use a high-compliance diaphragm, which helps to keep the earphones small, while still providing deep, rich bass sound. When streaming music via Bluetooth, LDAC is used to achieve Hi-Res Audio Wireless quality from compatible source devices like select Android smartphones and Bluetooth transmitters. DSEE Extreme is also utilized to upscale compressed music, working to restore the high range sound typically lost during compression. In addition to these technologies, Sony's Integrated Processor V1 chip adds improved noise cancellation, enhanced sound quality, and the reduction of distortion.Clear CallsBuilt-in microphones work in conjunction with an AI-based noise reduction algorithm to isolate your voice during hands-free calls.Long Battery LifeThe LinkBuds S supplies up to 6 hours of playback on a full charge, with an additional 14 hours available in the included charging case. When using Sony's Headphones Connect App, you can be notified on your mobile device when the charging case's battery level drops below 30%.Quick ChargeIf you forgot to charge your earphones, a quick 5-minute charge will get you up and running with up to an hour of playback time.Voice ControlSupporting both Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa, the LinkBuds S allows you to use your voice to operate many aspects of the headphones. Use your voice to manage music, make calls, get information, and even control various settings of the LinkBuds S.Easy PairingThe LinkBuds S supports both Swift Pair and Fast Pair. Swift Pair provides pop-up pairing guidance with compatible Windows 10 or 11 computers. Fast Pair is for Android-based devices, providing an easy-to-use pairing pop-up when the headphones are close to the device. Fast Pair also lets you find them if they go missing, either by sound or their last known location based on Google's Find My Device app.Quick AccessConfigure a two- or three-tap control to resume playback in either the Spotify or Endel app.Eco-FriendlySony continues their work to help the environment by manufacturing the LinkBuds S earphones from recycled plastic from automobile parts, and using packaging that is free of plastic.Additional FeaturesIPX4 water resistance can handle the rain or a workoutComfortable and lightweight, with four pair of silicone eartips and earphones weighing only 0.2 ozIntegrated touch controls that are customizable via the Headphones Connect appDolby Atmos and 360 Spatial Sound when paired with a BRAVIA XR TV using the WLA-NS7 wireless transmitter

name: Sony INZONE H7 Wireless Gaming Headset
description: Be the first to react with precise target detection Hear them before they see you. With 360 Spatial Sound for Gaming and our proven hardware technology, you can detect where your opponents are and how far away. Even players hiding in shadow, or behind walls and obstacles, can't stay hidden for long. Discover 360 Spatial Sound for Gaming Our 360 Spatial Sound for Gaming, activated by the PC software INZONE Hub, features a newly developed virtualiser for gaming that reproduces spatial sound out of multi-channel audio signals as the game creators intended. Also, with the smartphone app 360 Spatial Sound Personalizer, you'll get spatial sound optimised to your ear shape for truly personalised gameplay. Experience 360 Spatial Sound for Gaming Want to try our spatial sound on your favourite devices? Put your headphones on and immerse yourself. Feel precise expression of your opponent's position, movements, and more. Advanced technology optimises acoustics. We've designed our INZONE H7 headset to bring your game soundtrack to life. A symmetric acoustic structure, flexible enough to comfortably fit a variety of individual head shapes and sizes, enhances sound quality and spatial acoustic precision. Every gaming sound, authentically reproduced developed from our expertise in music headphones, the diaphragm of the INZONE H7 has a unique shape that allows it to reproduce extremely high frequency sounds with high compliance, as well as authentic low frequencies, for an immersive gaming experience. Powerful bass frequencies Ducts on the housing of the INZONE H7 control and optimise low frequency sound reproduction for powerful bass that makes deep sounds like explosions and engines seem incredibly real. Hear the drama and intensity of your gaming world all around you. Game for hours in comfort We've created the INZONE H7 to be ultra comfortable so you can keep on playing through extended sessions. Designed to be secure and stable when worn, with minimal side pressure, this is a headset that's ready to take into action for hours on end. Cushions your head perfectly. The wide, soft headband cushion spreads weight evenly across your head for long-term wearing comfort. Fits snugly around your ears Smooth nylon ear pads are shaped to minimise pressure on your ears by optimising contact with the side of your head. This extremely comfortable earpad material is designed for stability and sound insulation. Lead your team to victory with clear communications Coordinate missions clearly and decisively. A flexible flip-up boom microphone with mute function allows you to communicate effortlessly in-game with squad members. Boom microphone, voice-focused. The high quality boom microphone, shaped so it can be brought closer to your mouth, ensures you'll always be heard clearly. Because the microphone is bidirectional, your voice is picked up cleanly even during the most frenetic moments of a game. Discord Certified Rest assured your headset works well on the Discord voice, video and text communication service for seamless voice chat with friends while playing games online. Game freely - no wires, low delay Our INZONE H7 wireless gaming headset gives you the freedom to play without the stress of cables getting in the way. And thanks to low delay, you ll never miss a beat with tight sound and picture synchronisation. Power through a whole day of missions Enjoy gaming throughout the day and even the night with up to 40 hours of continuous play from one single charge. Simple oval design for effortless operation Our INZONE H7 features ergonomically designed control buttons and dials so you can easily change functions and adjust settings during a game. Left side controls On the left earcup are the main operation controls including the volume dial and mic mute. Simply flip the microphone up to mute. You also have the boom microphone and USB port with charging LED. Right side controls On the right earcup is the game / chat balance button, as well as power and Bluetooth buttons. Personalise your gameplay Our INZONE Hub PC software allows you to personalise your INZONE H7 experience by customising a wide range of operations, including a variety of sound and hardware settings. Fine tune sound frequencies to your game for more clarity and immersion using the EQ function. Perfect for PlayStation 5 INZONE H7 allows you to enjoy the immersive sound of PlayStation 5 s Tempest 3D AudioTech for gaming with greater spatial expression. Works seamlessly with PlayStation 5 consoles and special PS5 features for enhanced performance. Sustainability in mind Our products are not only designed to be stylish but also with the environment in mind. No plastic is included in the packaging material for the INZONE H7 and uses only recycled materials and non-woven cellulose, reflecting Sony s commitment to reducing the environmental impact of our products and practices

description: Stay connected when fixed Wi-Fi is not available with the Alcatel 3G USB dongle. description: Dominate your gameplay with the 24" Gaming Monitor featuring an ultra-fast 180Hz refresh rate for smooth, tear-free visuals. Its rapid response time ensures sharp, blur-free action, while adaptive sync technology minimizes stutter and screen tearing. name: ViewSonic 27" 180Hz Gaming Monitor
description: Take your gaming to the next level with the ViewSonic 27" Gaming Monitor, featuring an ultra-smooth 180Hz refresh rate for fluid motion and reduced input lag. Designed for competitive gamers, this monitor delivers stunning visuals with Full HD resolution and vibrant colors for an immersive experience. Its fast response time ensures sharp, blur-free action, while adaptive sync technology minimizes screen tearing. With ergonomic design, multiple connectivity options, and advanced eye-care features, it's perfect for long gaming sessions.

name: xTool - O1 Omni Printer - Single UV Rotary Bundle
description: The xTool O1 Omni Printer Single UV Rotary Bundle is a desktop UV printing bundle designed for creators, hobbyists, studios, schools, and small businesses focused on printing directly onto rigid hard goods. It supports UV direct printing and UV DTF decal workflows for items such as acrylic, wood, metal, glass, ceramic, phone cases, packaging, signage, promotional items, and custom gifts.The Rotary Bundle adds rotary-printing capability, making it suitable for cylindrical items such as tumblers, mugs, cups, bottles, and similar rounded products. xTool lists the Single UV Edition as the entry-level option for rigid material personalisation, with UV ink channels and one Epson F1080 printhead.

name: xTool - O1 Omni Printer - UV & DTG Versatile - Bundle
description: The xTool O1 Omni Printer UV & DTG Versatile Bundle is a desktop all-material printing system designed for creators, schools, studios, print shops, and small businesses that want to print across both hard goods and fabric products. It combines UV direct printing, UV DTF transfer printing, DTG printing, and DTF printing into one creative platform, allowing users to customise items such as acrylic signs, wood products, metal plates, glass, phone cases, tumblers, cotton T-shirts, hoodies, tote bags, polyester garments, and blended fabrics. xTool describes the O1 as a 4-in-1 Omni Printer built to print from rigid surfaces to fabric in one system.

name: xTool - P3 80W Flagship CO2 Laser Cutter
description: The xTool P3 is a flagship 80W CO? laser cutter and engraver designed for professional creators, workshops, schools, makerspaces, and small businesses that need high-speed cutting, engraving, and batch production. It offers a large 36" x 18" working area, intelligent automation, autofocus, LiDAR ranging, camera positioning, and an AutoLift base to simplify setup and improve production efficiency. As a CO? laser, it can process materials that diode lasers cannot, including clear acrylic and glass.

name: xTool - F2 Ultra UV 5W Laser Engraver- Stand Alone Unit
description: The xTool F2 Ultra UV Standalone 5W Laser Engraver is a professional desktop UV laser engraver designed for ultra-fine, clean engraving on delicate and difficult materials. Its 5W 355 nm UV laser uses cold-light processing, helping reduce burning, melting, charring, and heat damage. It is especially suitable for glass, crystal, acrylic, plastics, ceramics, leather, and other heat-sensitive materials. It also supports advanced applications such as 3D inner engraving on glass/crystal, precision surface engraving, embossing, cutting, and rotary engraving.

name: xTool - Honeycomb Panel 2.0 - P2/P2S
description: The xTool Honeycomb Panel 2.0 for P2 / P2S is a cutting bed accessory designed to improve cutting quality, material stability, and workflow efficiency when using the xTool P2 or xTool P2S CO2 Laser Cutter. Its honeycomb structure helps support smaller materials, reduces the chance of cut pieces falling through, and improves airflow during cutting to help reduce burning, scorching, and debris build-up. It is ideal for laser cutting, engraving, batch jobs, and small material processing.

name: xTool - 4 x 125ml CMYK ink & 1 x 290ml white ink
description: xTool - 4 x 125ml CMYK ink & 1 x 290ml white ink

name: xTool - F2 5W IR & 15W Diode Portable Dual Laser Engraver
description: The xTool F2 is a compact, portable dual-laser engraver designed for fast, accurate engraving and light cutting across a wide range of materials. It combines a 5W infrared laser for metals and plastics with a 15W diode laser for everyday materials such as wood, leather, acrylic, paper, and more. It also features a 50MP smart camera for live preview and precise design placement, making it ideal for on-site customisation, small-batch production, gifting, craft markets, and business use.

name: xTool - F2 Ultra 60W MOPA & 40W Diode Dual Laser Engraver - Stand Alone Unit
description: The xTool F2 Ultra is a professional desktop dual-laser engraver designed for high-speed metal marking, colour engraving, deep engraving, embossing, cutting, and detailed non-metal engraving. It combines a powerful 60W MOPA fiber laser for metals with a 40W diode laser for non-metal materials such as wood, acrylic, leather, paper, and more. The machine is built for premium customisation, jewellery marking, product branding, small-batch production, gifting, signage, and professional engraving businesses. xTool positions the dual-laser model as the option for users who need maximum versatility across both metal and non-metal materials.

name: xTool - S1 Enclosed Diode Laser Cutter 20W - Kit
description: The xTool S1 20W is a fully enclosed desktop diode laser cutter and engraver designed for safer, cleaner and more precise laser processing. It is suitable for creators, small businesses, workshops, schools and production environments that need reliable engraving and cutting on materials such as wood, leather, paper, cardboard and selected dark/opaque acrylic. The enclosed body improves safety compared to open-frame laser machines, while the 20W diode laser provides a strong balance between cutting power and fine engraving detail.

name: xTool - S1 Enclosed Diode Laser Cutter 40W - Kit
description: The xTool S1 40W is a fully enclosed desktop diode laser cutter and engraver designed for powerful cutting, precision engraving, and safer operation. With its 40W diode laser module, it offers stronger cutting performance than the 20W version, making it suitable for thicker wood, dark acrylic, leather, cardboard, paper, craft materials, signage, packaging, and small-batch production. The enclosed body, safety systems, autofocus, and pin-point positioning make it ideal for makers, schools, studios, workshops, and small businesses.

name: xTool - P2S 55W Desktop CO2 Laser Cutter
description: The xTool P2S is a smart desktop 55W CO? laser cutter and engraver designed for creators, schools, makerspaces, workshops, and small businesses. It offers powerful cutting, high-speed engraving, camera-assisted positioning, curved-surface engraving, and automatic passthrough support for longer materials. As a CO? laser machine, it is especially useful for materials like clear acrylic, wood, leather, glass, rubber, paper, cardboard, MDF, and fabric, making it a versatile option for signage, packaging, gifting, decor, model making, and small-batch production.

name: xTool - Screen Printer 2.0- Basic Kit
description: The xTool Screen Printer 2.0 Basic Kit is a desktop manual screen printing system designed to work with compatible xTool laser engravers. It allows users to create detailed screen-printing stencils by engraving pre-coated screens with a laser, removing the need for traditional emulsion coating, UV exposure, film positives, or washout processes. It is ideal for printing on items such as T-shirts, tote bags, posters, packaging, canvas, wood, leather, and other flat printable materials.Please note: a compatible xTool laser engraver is required and is not included in the Basic Kit.

name: xTool - M1 Ultra 20W 4-in-1 Craft Machine - Basic Kit
description: The xTool M1 Ultra 20W is an all-in-one desktop craft machine designed for makers, crafters, schools, small businesses, and DIY creators. It combines laser engraving/cutting, blade cutting, inkjet printing, and pen drawing in one compact machine, allowing users to create personalised gifts, decor, labels, apparel designs, cards, packaging, signage, and mixed-media craft projects. The 20W diode laser offers stronger cutting performance than the 10W version, while the multi-module design allows users to switch between creative functions for different materials and applications.

name: xTool - Auto StreamlineTM Conveyor
description: The xTool Auto StreamlineTM Conveyor is an automation accessory designed to expand the production capability of compatible xTool laser engravers. It allows users to process larger materials and perform batch engraving by automatically moving items through the laser's working area. It is ideal for small businesses, production studios, personalisation services, gifting, signage, jewellery marking, promotional products, and repetitive engraving jobs.It is compatible with the xTool F2 Ultra UV, xTool F2 Ultra, and xTool F1 Ultra laser systems. xTool's support centre lists dedicated setup and workflow guides for these three machines.

name: xTool - Desktop Smoke Purifier
description: The xTool Desktop Smoke Purifier is a compact air filtration accessory designed for smaller desktop xTool laser engravers. It helps remove smoke, dust, fumes, and odours produced during laser engraving or cutting, making it useful for home studios, offices, classrooms, craft markets, and small workshops. It uses a 3-layer filtration system with HEPA and activated carbon filtration and can work in sync with compatible xTool machines such as the xTool F1, F1 Lite, F2, and M1 Ultra.

name: xTool - Honeycomb Panel - S1
description: The xTool Honeycomb Panel for S1 is a cutting and engraving bed accessory designed for the xTool S1 laser cutter. Its honeycomb structure improves airflow, smoke diffusion, and heat dissipation during laser cutting, helping reduce burn marks and produce cleaner cutting results. It also protects the machine bed and provides a stable, measured work surface for material placement.

name: xTool - Slide Extension - F2/F1/F1 Lite
description: The xTool Slide Extension is an accessory designed to expand the working area of compatible xTool compact laser engravers. It allows users to engrave longer designs, process larger materials, and complete batch engraving jobs more efficiently. By increasing the work area to 115 x 400 mm, it gives the xTool F1, F1 Lite, and F2 more flexibility for signage, nameplates, gift items, product branding, and multiple-item engraving.

name: xTool - RA2 Pro Rotary Roller
description: The xTool RA2 Pro Rotary Roller is a 4-in-1 rotary attachment designed for laser engraving on round, curved, cylindrical, spherical, and ring-shaped objects. It allows compatible xTool laser machines to engrave items such as tumblers, mugs, bottles, wine glasses, rings, bracelets, balls, and other curved products. The RA2 Pro supports multiple rotary modes, making it suitable for personalisation, gifting, promotional products, jewellery engraving, and small-batch production. xTool support confirms that the RA2 Pro includes both roller and jaw chuck components, allowing it to work in both Roller and Chuck modes.

name: xTool - Riser Base - S1
description: The xTool S1 Riser Base is an accessory designed to raise the height of the xTool S1 laser cutter and engraver, allowing users to process taller materials and use additional accessories such as the RA2 Pro Rotary Roller and Automatic Conveyor Feeder. It increases the S1's working height, making it suitable for engraving tumblers, mugs, bottles, thicker materials, and longer conveyor-fed projects. xTool's support guide notes that the S1 changes from a Class 1 setup to a Class 4 laser machine when used with the riser base, so additional laser safety precautions are required.

name: xTool - Automatic Conveyor Feeder - S1
description: The xTool Automatic Conveyor Feeder for S1 is an accessory designed to expand the working area of the xTool S1 laser cutter and engraver. It automatically feeds longer materials through the machine, allowing users to engrave and cut larger projects or process multiple items more efficiently. It is ideal for signage, long-format engraving, batch cutting, decor, panels, templates, packaging, and production workflows.The feeder must be used with the xTool S1 and the S1 Riser Base that supports conveyor feeding. xTool's support guide states that it is designed specifically to feed materials in conveying mode for longer material processing.

name: xTool - Honeycomb Panel - P3
description: The xTool Honeycomb Panel for P3 is a lightweight aluminium cutting bed accessory designed for the xTool P3 80W CO2 Laser Cutter. Its honeycomb structure improves airflow, smoke release, and heat dissipation during cutting, helping reduce back-burn, scorch marks, and edge discolouration. It provides a stable working surface for cleaner, more precise laser cutting and engraving results.

name: xTool - F1 Pedal Switch
description: The xTool F1 Pedal Switch is an external foot-control accessory designed for compatible xTool F-Series laser engravers. It allows users to start, pause, continue, or repeat engraving jobs without touching the laser machine, helping improve stability, accuracy, and workflow efficiency. It is especially useful for batch engraving, production work, and situations where hands-free control is more convenient. xTool lists the pedal/button switch as a workflow accessory for F-Series machines.

name: xTool - F1 Ultra 20W Fiber & Diode Dual Laser Engraver
description: The xTool F1 Ultra is a compact dual-laser engraver designed for high-speed engraving, metal marking, deep engraving, embossing, and thin metal cutting. It combines a 20W fiber laser for metals and plastics with a 20W diode laser for materials such as wood, leather, acrylic, paper, and more. With speeds of up to 10,000 mm/s, built-in camera positioning, autofocus, and an enclosed safety design, it is ideal for small businesses, creators, personalisation services, jewellery marking, corporate gifting, and small-batch production.

name: xTool - M1 Ultra Replacement Blades - (3pcs)
description: The xTool M1 Ultra Replacement Blades are spare cutting blades designed for the xTool M1 Ultra 4-in-1 Craft Machine. They are used to replace worn or dull blades to maintain clean, accurate cutting performance across craft materials such as paper, vinyl, cardstock, HTV, felt, leather, burlap, fabric, and other compatible materials. Different blade types are available depending on the cutting application, including fine-point cutting, standard cutting, and rotary cutting. xTool's support guide confirms blade replacement for the M1 Ultra, including the cutting blade, fine-point blade, rotary blade, and foil transfer tip.

name: xTool - M1 Ultra Replacement Rotary Blade Kit - (3pcs)
description: The xTool M1 Ultra Replacement Kit is a spare blade kit designed for the xTool M1 Ultra Rotary Blade. It includes replacement rotary disc cutters that help maintain smooth, accurate cutting performance when working with flexible craft materials. It is ideal for replacing dull or worn rotary blades to keep cuts clean and precise across fabric, leather, vinyl, paper, and other compatible materials.

name: xTool - F1 Button Switch
description: The xTool F1 Button Switch is a control accessory designed to improve engraving workflow on compatible xTool F-Series laser engravers. It allows users to start, pause, continue, or repeat engraving tasks without pressing the button directly on the laser machine, helping reduce movement, improve stability, and speed up batch engraving. It is especially useful when positioning materials, running repeated jobs, or working in a production setup.

name: xTool - SafetyProTM Air Purifier
description: The xTool SafetyProTM Air Purifier is a smoke and fume filtration system designed for use with xTool laser engravers and laser cutters. It helps capture dust, smoke, odours, and harmful particles produced during laser engraving and cutting, creating a cleaner and safer workspace. The SafetyPro AP2 model uses SuperCyclone technology and a multi-layer filtration system to improve filter life and reduce airborne contaminants.

name: xTool - Laser Safety Goggles
description: The xTool Laser Safety Goggles are protective eyewear designed to help shield the user's eyes from harmful laser radiation during engraving, cutting, and marking tasks. They are suitable for use with selected xTool laser machines and help filter common diode, infrared, and fibre laser wavelength ranges. They are ideal for workshops, studios, classrooms, home users, and production environments where additional eye protection is required during laser operation.

name: xTool - RA3 Rotary Roller Kit
description: The xTool RA3 Rotary Roller Kit is a smart rotary engraving accessory designed for compatible xTool laser machines. It allows users to engrave around cylindrical, spherical, ring-shaped, and irregular curved objects, making it ideal for tumblers, mugs, bottles, glasses, rings, ornaments, vases, and other round products. The RA3 uses a MagSwapTM tool-free design, allowing users to switch between rotary modes quickly for different object types.
